postings.title: Customer Success Manager - Spain (m/f/d)
postings.description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here
Your mission as a Customer Success Manager

As Appinio continues to revolutionise and conquer the market research industry, we are dedicated to continuously delivering exceptional experiences to our clients. Our Customer Success Team plays a fundamental role in this mission by driving client satisfaction, adoption, and retention. As we continue to grow, we are seeking a dedicated Customer Success Manager to join our Spanish team and drive the success of our growing portfolio of accounts.

As a Customer Success Manager, you will manage a portfolio of clients and act as a trusted advisor, helping them effectively integrate customer insights into their day-to-day decisions and maximize product adoption to achieve strong ROI.

This role requires candidates to be based in Spain. 

What you’ll be doing

- End-to-End Research Project Management: Manage multiple concurrent tracking and ad-hoc projects from kickoff to final delivery. Work in close alignment with the Research Consulting team to ensure seamless execution, overseeing timeline tracking, scope alignment, quality checks, and timely data delivery

- Daily Operational Contact: Serve as the primary point of contact for daily client requests, coordinating project execution, technical troubleshooting, and status updates across your account portfolio

- Research Scoping & Execution: Translate client research questions into actionable study designs and methodologies, guiding users on how to launch and execute effective surveys on the Appinio platform

- Hands-on Onboarding & Enablement: Prepare and lead tactical client onboarding, functional platform trainings, and workshops (virtually and on-site) to empower teams to build and analyze studies independently

- Project Workflow & Account Health: Track ongoing study activity and usage metrics, proactively intervening to resolve execution blockers, maintain timeline momentum, and safeguard account satisfaction

- Cross-Functional Delivery: Collaborate closely with internal Research Ops, Product, and Account Management teams to ensure smooth study completion, route expansion opportunities, and feed direct user feedback into product development

You will thrive in this role if

- You have a solid background in Market Research or experience working with data/insight-driven solutions

- You have proven experience supporting and consulting B2B customers in a Customer Success or Account Management role

- You excel at balancing customer success and satisfaction with account retention and growth objectives

- You are proficient in Spanish (C2 level) and fluent in English

- You bring a hands-on mentality, pragmatism, and proactivity, with the ability to solve client problems independently

- You are an active listener who communicates clearly and confidently, with the ability to present complex data in an engaging, easy-to-understand way

What’s in it for you?

- Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year

- All the hardware you need and your own MacBook

- If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space

- Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location

- In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.

Appinio is an equal-opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

Please read our privacy policy here.

postings.title: General Manager DACH
postings.description:
Allow us to introduce ourselves

Hello there! We’re Appinio, a global market research company that combines an AI-powered insights platform with expert consultancy. On a mission to make the world a little more fact-based, we help companies understand how consumers think and make smarter decisions.

We started out in Hamburg back in 2014, but we’re now humbled to call the world our playground, with over 260 employees spread across 13 countries (we’re remote-first), 2600+ international clients, delivering research from +190 markets, globally.

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here

Your mission as a General Manager

DACH is Appinio’s flagship market and primary revenue driver. Instead of building from zero, you will step into an established, high-performing organization to drive its next phase of scale and operational maturity.

Your mission is to establish single-point leadership across the region. You will own the DACH strategy and P&L, represent Appinio as our primary brand ambassador on industry stages, lead complex enterprise negotiations, and optimize our cross-functional GTM teams and further accelerate growth.

What you’ll be doing 

- Own GTM Strategy & Decision-Making: Serve as the final authority on DACH market strategy, priorities, and resource allocation, focus on creating internal alignment, resource planning and establishing a clear operating rhythm across teams.

- Hold End-to-End P&L Accountability: Take a holistic view across Marketing, Sales, Customer Success (CS), to identify where to optimize, invest, or restructure to maximize regional growth and operating margin.

- Lead Complex Enterprise Deals: Personally lead or co-lead high-stakes commercial negotiations and enterprise client pitches, leveraging deep Quantitative Market Research expertise to establish instant authority.

- Act as Appinio’s Brand Ambassador: Publicly represent Appinio across the DACH region—owning stage presentations, keynotes, media opportunities, and executive network-building to become the primary face of the brand in-market.

- Drive Cross-Functional Alignment: Directly lead DACH Marketing, Sales, and CS leads while building a tight, influential strategic partnership with the Research Consulting group to ensure seamless alignment between strategy and research delivery.

You will thrive in this role if

- You bring proven operational discipline in scale: You have a strong track record scaling or optimizing an established, multi-functional organization in a mature market context (ideally DACH), demonstrating structural thinking and governance over "0-to-1 founder mode" hustle.

- You possess deep Quantitative Market Research authority: You hold, credible domain expertise in Quant MR (agency, vendor, or tech platform side) and can step into high-stakes technical or methodological discussions with senior client insights leads without ramp-up.

- You have hands-on P&L management experience: You have successfully owned and optimized a regional or global P&L in a mature business environment, making cross-functional resource tradeoffs to drive overall market performance.

- You are a confident, high-profile public spokesperson: You are charismatic and experienced on stage, comfortable in front of press and industry bodies, and hold (or can rapidly build) strong executive credibility within DACH insights and marketing circles.

- You excel at leading through influence: You have demonstrated political skill and stakeholder diplomacy, allowing you to align and lead cross-functional teams that may not directly report to you.

- You bring a strong GTM focus and operational savvy: You possess KPI-driven leadership for GTM teams paired with AI savvy regarding automation across GTM functions.

- You are fluent in German and English: You possess native or bilingual fluency in German alongside professional fluency in English.

What’s in it for you?

- Flexibility Policy - Average is 30 days taken, however, we do not have a hard cap of number of vacation days as we know life happens

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year

- All the hardware you need and your own MacBook

- If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space

- Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location

- In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Additional role details

- This is a fully remote position open to candidates based in Germany, ideally in Hamburg

- This role will report directly to our Chief Revenue Office

Our interview process

- Screening Call

- Interview with our CEO

- Interview with our COO

- Case study Interview

- Stakeholder Interview

- Executive Interview with our CPRO

- Reference Check

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

Your mission as a (Senior) Research Consultant

We are looking for a (Senior) Research Consultant (m/f/d) with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region.

This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.

What you’ll be doing

- End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.

- Methodology & Study Design: Optimise bespoke study designs across core use cases (e.g., Target Group Analysis, U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing) mainly tailored to hard-to-reach professional audiences.

- Senior Client Sparring & Advisory: Act as a trusted research partner to leading global consulting firms and major corporate clients. Work directly with experienced consultants and senior stakeholders to translate business questions into robust research approaches, advise on sample feasibility and survey methodology, and make pragmatic decisions when timelines are tight.

- Commercial & Scoping Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on project scoping, feasibility checks, and methodology definition for complex project requests.

- Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.

You will thrive in this role if

- You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market research with a distinct focus on surveying B2B target groups and professional decision-makers (agency or consulting background required; pure academic or non-client backgrounds will not fit this role).

- You have hands-on experience designing studies, writing questionnaires, and executing quantitative projects across core B2B use cases (e.g., U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing, Target Group Analysis).

- You bring proven experience creating executive-ready reports and presenting complex data through clear, compelling storytelling to senior client-side stakeholders.

- You possess a strategic, commercially minded approach with the self-confidence to guide clients and defend research decisions under pressure.

- You excel in high-velocity environments, with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under tight deadlines.

- You are proficient in German (C2 level required) and English, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- You bring a pragmatic, proactive, and resilient mindset with a passion for data quality and innovation.

What’s in it for you?

- Flexibility Policy - Our flexibility policy means there is no hard cap on the number of vacation days you can take

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year

Want to be a part of the Appinio movement? 🚀

Here at Appinio, we value transparency in our recruitment process, and we've created a blog to share what to expect during each step of our journey together: here
Your mission as a (Senior) Research Consultant

We are looking for a (Senior) Research Consultant (m/f/d) with a strong quantitative market research background to join our newly dedicated B2B research team in the DACH region.

This specialized unit focuses on research projects that specifically survey B2B target groups, professional decision-makers, and niche business audiences (rather than only standard B2C consumer panels). You will work closely with leading global strategy and management consultancies as well as major international corporates, supporting high-stakes projects where research needs to be delivered quickly, precisely, and with a clear focus on the business question.

What you’ll be doing

- End-to-End B2B Project Lead: Manage quantitative research projects end-to-end, including B2B screening design, questionnaire drafting, platform setup, fieldwork monitoring, and data delivery.

- Methodology & Study Design: Optimise bespoke study designs across core use cases (e.g., Target Group Analysis, U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing) mainly tailored to hard-to-reach professional audiences.

- Senior Client Sparring & Advisory: Act as a trusted research partner to leading global consulting firms and major corporate clients. Work directly with experienced consultants and senior stakeholders to translate business questions into robust research approaches, advise on sample feasibility and survey methodology, and make pragmatic decisions when timelines are tight.

- Commercial & Scoping Collaboration: Partner closely with Sales and Account Management on project scoping, feasibility checks, and methodology definition for complex project requests.

- Process & Quality Enhancement: Contribute to standardizing B2B screening protocols, sampling frameworks, and best practices to coach other researcher and safeguard delivery speed and research quality across the team.

You will thrive in this role if

- You have 5+ years of experience in quantitative market research with a distinct focus on surveying B2B target groups and professional decision-makers (agency or consulting background required; pure academic or non-client backgrounds will not fit this role).

- You have hands-on experience designing studies, writing questionnaires, and executing quantitative projects across core B2B use cases (e.g., U&A, Pricing studies, Concept Testing, Target Group Analysis).

- You bring proven experience creating executive-ready reports and presenting complex data through clear, compelling storytelling to senior client-side stakeholders.

- You possess a strategic, commercially minded approach with the self-confidence to guide clients and defend research decisions under pressure.

- You excel in high-velocity environments, with a demonstrated ability to juggle multiple concurrent projects, prioritize effectively, and stay calm under tight deadlines.

- You are proficient in German (C2 level required) and English, with outstanding written and verbal communication skills.

- You bring a pragmatic, proactive, and resilient mindset with a passion for data quality and innovation.

What’s in it for you?

- Flexibility Policy - Our flexibility policy means there is no hard cap on the number of vacation days you can take

- Temporary work from abroad - If you're based in the EU, you can work outside your country of residence for up to 180 days per year

- All the hardware you need and your own MacBook

- If you are located in Hamburg or Berlin, you'll get a Deutschland ticket or access to a mobility budget with the NAVIT app to get you to and from the office space

- Subsidised Urban Sports Club or ClassPass membership based on location

- In case you’re located in one of the cities where most of our fellow Appinioneers are (Hamburg, Berlin, Munich, London, Madrid, Barcelona, or New York), you can get access to our Co-working spaces

Kind reminder: Please ensure that your application is submitted in English.

This post not only outlines our ideal candidate but also serves as an inspiration for what this role can evolve into. Even if you consider yourself an 80% fit but have a genuine passion for this position, we encourage you to apply. We're eager to hear from individuals who share our enthusiasm.
